evaluation_mode: Current assistant chooses CLI requests after each result. Task outcomes are assistant assessments, not an independent-model benchmark.

tasks.requirement: Find saved logic converting requested acceleration into braking force. Identify sign, scaling and inputs using a complete implementation.
Find driver braking force to pressure conversion. Explain the implemented conditions and formula without inventing Dataset values.
Find a BDE use of interpolation or lookup. Identify the referenced Component, its external Pins and one actual connection, then locate a saved called implementation if available.
Locate an acceleration-controller integrator. Explain reset or limiting behavior using saved code and distinguish external wiring from the implementation.
Find a Module Process involved in AEB input preparation and read a real connected processing Component. Do not infer runtime scheduling from the Process name.
Find Init in a class outside the previously inspected AEB_State_Machine. Identify whether it is saved text or a Diagram and read its complete supported representation.
Find vehicle-hold timing in an automatic braking State Machine. Read the saved increment/reset logic and distinguish State code from Transition code.
Find a BDE Hierarchy with a real boundary, read both endpoint objects, and distinguish structural connectivity from inferred Component data dependencies.
Locate an if/else code fragment spanning multiple lines in a newly explored implementation. Verify the match against a full read and preserve the member identity.

Search AxAct, VxAct and FxDriver together, use limited pages, then narrow a Component and batch-read relevant text members. Explain per-query counts and continuation without assuming the queries are AND.
Search a distinctive non-existent code identifier and report only what a complete zero-hit result establishes; do not claim absence from declarations, Dataset or unsupported sources.
Determine whether code-search can establish actual runtime task scheduling or execution frequency from a Module Process and Sequence notes. Separate saved facts from unsupported runtime assertions.
